what: The Gazette PDF at gazettes.gov.gd is damaged (a compression error; re-downloading gives the same file). Page 702 stops after A04 and page 710 is blank, so A04 (registered)–A11, B01–B06, H09, J01–J07 and K01–K07 are unreadable. Carriacou & PM, St. Andrew SE, St. George NE, St. George NW and St. George SE therefore have no constituency result. Together they hold 3,656 Yes and 3,985 No.
action: Ask the Government Printery (govprintery@gov.gd) or the PEO for an undamaged copy of Gazette No. 52 of 2018 or the certified results sheets.
